title: 12 Best Seafood Markets in Marseille
description: The best seafood markets, fish stalls, and poissonneries in Marseille — curated from Reddit and local sources.

picks.name: Marché aux Poissons du Vieux-Port
picks.verdict: The soul of Marseille — every morning, local fishermen sell the catch they hauled in at dawn, directly on the Vieux-Port quay.

picks.name: Toinou, les Fruits de Mer
picks.verdict: Marseille's most famous shellfish institution since 1956 — oysters, sea urchins, prawns, and towering plateaux de fruits de mer.

picks.name: La Boîte à Sardine
picks.verdict: The most creative seafood restaurant in Marseille — daily-changing menu based on what the boats brought in.

picks.name: Chez Fonfon
picks.address: 140 Rue du Vallon des Auffes, 13007 Marseille
picks.verdict: The most atmospheric place to eat bouillabaisse in Marseille — perched on the Vallon des Auffes fishing port.

picks.name: Pêcherie Marseillaise
picks.verdict: A proper Marseillais fishmonger in the heart of the Noailles neighborhood.

picks.name: La Criée du Marché des Argonautes
picks.verdict: The highest-rated fishmonger in Marseille at 4.5 stars.

picks.name: Marché de Noailles
picks.verdict: Marseille's most vibrant multicultural street market — spice shops, fish stalls, and North African grocers.

picks.name: Chez Jeannot
picks.address: 129 Rue du Vallon des Auffes, 13007 Marseille
picks.verdict: Budget-friendly neighbor of Chez Fonfon at the Vallon des Auffes — same stunning views, half the price.

picks.name: Saladin World of Spices
picks.verdict: The anchor of the Noailles spice market — essential for bouillabaisse ingredients.

picks.name: L'Estaque Fish Village
picks.verdict: A working fishing village within Marseille city limits — take the boat from the Vieux-Port.

picks.name: Marché du Prado
picks.verdict: The locals' market — Fri/Sat on Avenue du Prado with excellent fish vendors.

picks.name: Marché de la Plaine
picks.verdict: The bohemian market — Tue/Thu/Sat with artsy crowd and excellent fish stalls.
